summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with four helper methods and the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty-class cases. Nothing was run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Deviations: the cross-sample TP and D sums are factored (sum over samples of (1 - W) or (2 - W), then gathered alpha times that, summed over voxels), which is algebraically identical to the full (b, s, voxel) sum but cheaper. The distance lookup uses advanced indexing rather than torch.gather. A float64 numpy matrix is not cast, so the loss can be float64. Nothing was committed.
